{{Quote|I apologize for my fading enthusiasm, but I've been waiting for quite some time for a shipment of goods to arrive. These two shipwrights have been waiting with me, and one of them is becoming especially belligerent.|[[Ral Mundi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
'''Io Tsomcren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] shipwright who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tarth Jaxx and another Mon Calamari shipwright, [[Tarth Jaxx]], ordered a large shipment of starship component to [[Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium]], in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. However, when Jaxx and Tsomcren arrived in the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]], the shipment was missing. [[Ral Mundi]] was confuse for the situation and deeply apologized for the delay. However, as the shipment did not show up Jaxx started to become hostile, while Tsomcren remained comprehensive. Mundi thus requested assistance of the [[Corellian Security Force]] and CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] sent a spacer to investigate.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> The spacer discovered that the shipment was stolen by the [[Ragtags|Ragtag gang]] but finally managed to retrieve it. However, de to the Ragtag involvement, the shipwrights did not get the shipment immediately as the CorSec decide to hold it as evidence.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:TsomcrenMundiJaxx.jpg|250px|thumb|Io Tsomcren alongside [[Ral Mundi]] and [[Tarth Jaxx]] in Coronet City]]

==Behind the scenes==
Io Tsomcren was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Ral Mundi, Tarth Jaxx and Io Tsomcren were added to the game with the expansion ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', released on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. This NPCs were originally three "greeter NPCs": NPCs present at the entrance of starports to provide general information to players arriving on a new planet.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> a new quest featuring Ral Mundi, Tarth Jaxx and Io Tsomcren was added to the game. The quest, named "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components", was best known as "Ral Mundi's quest".<ref name="SWG:TTE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components"</ref> Ral Mundi's quest was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /><ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />
